get.summary: Get personalized timeline feed with chronological grouping

Each post includes media with thumbnail_url, compressed_url, and url. Optimized for 100k DAU with Redis-cached social graph and indexed DB queries. MNT-313: Pass an IANA timezone via the X-Timezone request header (e.g. 'Europe/Athens') so that posts are bucketed by the client's local date. Defaults to UTC.

get.summary: Get discover feed of public posts from non-followed accounts
get.description: Serves three feeds from one endpoint. Legacy flat feed (no startScope, no location parameters): category-weighted, offset-paginated, response shape {posts, meta}. Area feed (startScope=CITY|COUNTRY|GLOBAL, cursor-paginated, response shape {items, next_cursor}): CITY matches city+country together, COUNTRY matches country, GLOBAL matches everything and honours includeUnlocated (ignored at CITY/COUNTRY). Nearby feed (lat+lng+radius all present, cursor-paginated, response shape {items, next_cursor}): returns posts ring by ring outward from the anchor point, nearest first, boundaries taken from backend configuration, ending at the outermost ring without continuing into city, country or global posts; includeUnlocated has no effect on it, since a post with no coordinates can never be inside a circle; a nearby request takes precedence when a start area is also sent. Like the area feed, it emits a widening announcement item when it crosses a ring boundary. Seen posts are permanently excluded on every feed; this endpoint does NOT mark posts as seen.

parameters.description: Country name, required for CITY and COUNTRY scope
parameters.name: country
